body.name: \omega_x(p_x)
body.def: \(\sup \max_{s\in\mathcal I_x(p_x)}\|(I-\bar a_{x,s}\bar a_{x,s}^\top)Da_{x,s}(p_x)[h]\|\), where the supremum is over \(h\) satisfying \(\|h\|=1\), \(\sum_{a\in\mathcal A,\,y\in\{0,1\}}h_{zay}=0\) for every \(z\in\mathcal Z\), and \(h_{zay}=0\) whenever \(p_{xzay}=0\); set the supremum to zero when no such unit direction exists, and set \(\bar a_{x,s}=a_{x,s}/\|a_{x,s}\|\).
